results.detail: I re-derived every unit from the raw DTSX, which has 38 lines and was read in full. [1] The only Execute SQL Task runs 'Update Gen_fundmainBase set Gen_depositmfpercentage = 0 where Gen_depositmfpercentage = 9.9' and 'Update Gen_customeraccountBase set Gen_depositmfpercentage = 0 Where Gen_depositmfpercentage = 9.9' on [CRM]. These are direct SQL updates on the Base tables, so the claim of Unsupported is correct. The field meaning and the meaning of 9.9 are both labelled השערה. The text names Gen_fundmain/Gen_customeraccount and then states explicitly that the Base tables are updated. [2] The package has one executable, no data flows, no variables (<DTS:Variables/>), no DTS:Configurations (evidence configurations = []), no event handlers, no log providers and no logging options. Evidence coverage is all match:true. The single connection is [CRM] with 'Data Source=PSQL;Initial Catalog=ALTSHULER_MSCRM' (DTSX:6). This package loads no config file, so the design-time string is the only one in the package, and the possible dtexec /CONN override is stated as unknown. The 0014 cross-reference is correct. 0014 [CRM] = 'Data Source=Psql;Initial Catalog=ALTSHULER_MSCRM' (0014 DTSX:6). Its source 'get restrictions and accounts balance' uses [CRM] (0014 DTSX:3910) and reads 'from gen_accountcourses ac' (0014 DTSX:3897). 0014 DTSX:17 is the C:\Generix\SSISConfigFile.dtsConfig configuration. Nothing is disabled and there are no precedence constraints. Note, not counted: the package Description reads 'backup all tabales that will be changed in end of year process', which does not match the UPDATE task. The claim does not use it.
